gaps.note: A non-empty stamp alone is expressible, but its derivation from a content hash of the daemon's module directory is process behaviour beyond the grammar
Connect-else-spawn with a detached child process is process lifecycle outside the grammar
Shutdown-and-respawn on stamp mismatch is multi-process coordination outside the grammar
The three-attempt cap ends in a thrown error, which is outside the assertion grammar
The mkdir lock, 10 s wait, and 60 s staleness window are cross-process coordination outside the grammar
The stop-listen, drain (10 s), close, release (5 s), exit ordering is process lifecycle outside the grammar
The LENS_BROKER_NO_BROWSER_EXIT_MS window (default 10 s) is timed process lifecycle outside the grammar
The LENS_BROKER_IDLE_EXIT_MS window (default 15 m, 0 disables) is timed process lifecycle outside the grammar
Re-checking idleness when the timer fires is timing behaviour outside the grammar
Opt-in idle lease release via LENS_BROKER_IDLE_RELEASE_MS is environment-driven behaviour outside the grammar
The release/acquire/status/shutdown control actions mutate broker state the grammar cannot reference
Resolving pending calls with a disconnect error on socket close is event-driven behaviour outside the grammar
Listening on 127.0.0.1 only is network configuration the assertion grammar cannot state
